title: Pure Morphtronic
summary: Morphtronic cards only, with generic Synchros, Links and staples. Every Morphtronic has one effect in Attack Position and another in Defense Position, and the deck flips them between the two. The 2022 cards lead. Morphtronic Telefon gains LP and revives a Morphtronic in Attack Position, or excavates and mills one in Defense. Morphtronic Scannen banishes a Morphtronic to summon itself, then searches a Morphtronic Spell/Trap or recovers a monster. Morphtronic Converter swaps an Attack Position Machine for another Morphtronic from the Deck. Morphtronic Earfon makes a monster a Tuner and equips to a Synchro. Morphtronic Impact Return shuffles away two of their Spells/Traps. Morphtronic Remoten and Smartfon search, and Morphtronic Slingen tributes another Morphtronic to destroy a card.
